newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR East down on JR West auction result.
newsitem.headline: JR East down on JR West auction result.

text.p: Shares in East Japan Railway Co (JR East) fell early in Wednesday's morning session, depressed by the results of the auction of West Japan Railway Corp (JR West) shares, brokers said.
By 0046 GMT, JR East shares had shed 10,000 yen to stand at 509,000 on speculation that the JR West shares will turn out to be cheaper than JR East, which prompted selling, they said.
On Tuesday, the Japan National Railways Settlement Corp announced it had accepted 675,100 bids for the 750,000 JR West shares it was offering through the auction.
The weighted average auction price of the JR West shares was not revealed, but market sources estimate the fixed share price to be around the 350,000 yen level.
